name: Majo Kuruibana
source:
Kuro, the protagonist, had lost her mother to a witch at a young age.
Driven by a thirst for revenge, Kuro enrolls in the "Witch Academy", an institution where that very same witch reigns supreme as Headmistress.

A light-hearted "Revenge Yuri Visual Novel" in which you strive to reach the top of the academy alongside a cast of adorable witches.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/13677]Novelgame[/url]]
